agents.name: Manager
agents.role: Owns the goal, assigns work, checks progress, and escalates blockers.
agents.successMetric: Tasks move toward validated revenue without unnecessary spend.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Finds markets with observable demand and real-world evidence.
agents.successMetric: Returns evidence-backed opportunities that meet hard filters.

agents.name: Evidence Reviewer
agents.role: Rejects weak opportunities and verifies that claims are supported.
agents.successMetric: Weak ideas are killed before build time or money is wasted.

agents.name: Offer Builder
agents.role: Turns validated demand into a concrete sellable offer.
agents.successMetric: Produces a testable offer with a clear buyer, result, price, and pilot.

agents.name: Prospector
agents.role: Finds real prospects that match the validated offer.
agents.successMetric: Finds qualified prospects using public evidence without inventing problems.

agents.name: Sales Agent
agents.role: Builds personalized outreach and sales angles from verified prospect data.
agents.successMetric: Creates outreach that earns replies and conversations.

agents.name: Demo Builder
agents.role: Builds the smallest convincing demo needed to test willingness to pay.
agents.successMetric: A prospect can understand the value in under three minutes.

agents.name: War Room
agents.role: Measures experiments, identifies waste, and recommends kill, continue, or scale decisions.
agents.successMetric: Resources move away from weak experiments and toward proven ones.

agents.name: Treasury
agents.role: Tracks API, software, ad, and operating costs against experiment results.
agents.successMetric: Experiments stay inside approved budgets and cost is visible.

agents.name: Archives
agents.role: Stores decisions, outputs, results, failures, and lessons so the system does not repeat mistakes.
agents.successMetric: Every important decision and experiment result is recoverable.
